apply.title: Boston College Admission - Apply (deadlines and requirements)

test_policy.notes: Boston College offers a test-optional admission policy; applicants who do not submit scores receive full consideration. Non-submitters remain eligible for the Gabelli Presidential Scholars Program if they apply by November 1. English proficiency exams are still required for non-US citizens (the test-optional policy does not cover them).

requirements.supplemental_essays: BC Writing Supplement via Common App: answer one of the first four 2026-27 prompts (400-word limit); Human-Centered Engineering applicants answer Prompt 5 instead.
requirements.notes: Fee waivers are for US citizens or permanent residents with financial hardship, requested through the Common App. Mid-year report required for Regular Decision and deferred Early Decision applicants. No general admission interview is described; optional InitialView video interview for students at national schools in China. Spring first-year admission available (not for Human-Centered Engineering or Nursing).

deadlines.label: Gabelli Presidential Scholars Program
deadlines.notes: Per the test-optional page, non-submitters remain eligible if they apply by November 1.

deadlines.label: InitialView results (ED I)
deadlines.notes: Optional interview; due January 15, 2027 for ED II and Regular Decision. Does not replace the English proficiency requirement.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Non-US citizens must submit TOEFL iBT, IELTS or Duolingo; not covered by test-optional. Waived for native English speakers, applicants with 3+ years at a US or other majority-English-country school in a non-ESOL curriculum, or SAT EBRW 650+ / ACT English 29+. No superscoring; TOEFL MyBest scores not considered; at-home IELTS/TOEFL not accepted per search summary of the page.

english.notes: Recommended minimum; TOEFL reports both 120-point and 6-point scales until January 2028.
Recommended minimum on the new scale; admitted students typically average 5.5.

aid.notes: BC is unable to provide need-based financial aid to students who are not US citizens or permanent residents; international students should expect to pay full cost. Merit aid for international students is not described on the international page; the 2024-2025 CDS (H6) reports non-need-based institutional aid to 20 nonresident undergraduates. Gabelli Presidential Scholars merit program exists (eligibility for international applicants not confirmed).

toefl.note: No TOEFL code published on BC's international page; select Boston College by name in the ETS institution search.

ielts.note: No numeric code published on BC's international page.

duolingo.note: No numeric code published on BC's international page.

tier_notes.nursing: Connell School of Nursing is a top-15 undergraduate nursing program.
tier_notes.engineering: Human-Centered Engineering program is new (first class 2021) and small.
